legal.privacy_subtitle: How FocusMatrix processes your personal data under the EU GDPR / DSGVO.
legal.priv_cat_account_body: Name, email, password hash, job title, locale, 2FA settings.
legal.priv_cat_usage_body: IP address, session cookies, browser user agent, last activity timestamp.
legal.priv_cat_content_body: Tasks, delegations, weekly self‑check answers, kill list items, organisation checks.
legal.priv_cat_integrations_body: OAuth access/refresh tokens for connected services (Google Calendar); your own API keys for Gemini / OpenAI / Anthropic, all stored encrypted at rest.
legal.priv_cat_billing_body: Stripe customer ID, subscription status, invoice references (no card numbers — handled exclusively by Stripe).
legal.priv_purpose_body: We process your data solely to provide, secure, improve and bill the FocusMatrix service, and to comply with legal obligations. We do not sell personal data and do not use it for advertising profiles.
legal.priv_basis_contract: Performance of the contract (your subscription / free account).
legal.priv_basis_consent: Your consent, e.g. optional integrations or AI features.
legal.priv_basis_legitimate: Our legitimate interest in operating a secure, reliable service.
legal.priv_processors_intro: We share data with the following processors, each bound by Art. 28 GDPR data processing agreements:
legal.priv_processor_google: OAuth for Google Calendar (if you connect it).
legal.priv_processor_ai: Only the task or self‑check text you explicitly send is transmitted when you use AI features with your own key.
legal.priv_processor_ai_note: Note: AI providers may be based outside the EU — their use is optional and only triggered when you add a key.
legal.priv_retention_body: Account & content data are kept while your account exists and for up to 30 days after deletion for backup rotation. Billing records are retained for 10 years as required by German tax law (§ 147 AO).
legal.priv_rights_intro: Under the GDPR you have the right to:
legal.priv_right_access: Access (Art. 15) — request a copy of your data.
legal.priv_right_erase: Erasure (Art. 17) — have your account and content deleted.
legal.priv_right_portability: Portability (Art. 20) — receive your data in a machine‑readable format (we export JSON).
legal.priv_right_object: Objection (Art. 21) — object to processing based on legitimate interests.
legal.priv_right_complaint: Lodge a complaint with the Bavarian Data Protection Authority (BayLDA) or your local DPA.
legal.priv_cookies_body: We only use essential session cookies. See our cookie policy for details.
legal.priv_security_body: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt, API keys and OAuth tokens are encrypted with AES‑256‑CBC (Laravel app key). Transport is TLS 1.2+.
legal.terms_subtitle: The contract between you and FocusMatrix.
legal.terms_service_body: FocusMatrix is a productivity software‑as‑a‑service that helps managers apply the Only‑You‑Principle to their daily work.
legal.terms_account_body: You are responsible for the accuracy of your account information and for keeping your credentials confidential. Do not share accounts across multiple people — use Team seats instead.
legal.terms_acc_1: No unlawful, infringing or harmful content.
legal.terms_acc_2: No attempts to reverse‑engineer, circumvent security or overload the service.
legal.terms_acc_3: No use of the service to train third‑party ML models on extracted data.
legal.terms_acc_4: Respect the intellectual property rights of others when delegating or storing content.
legal.terms_billing_body: Paid plans renew automatically each month. Prices exclude VAT; EU business customers entering a valid VAT ID are charged reverse‑charge. Invoices are available in the Stripe billing portal.
legal.terms_cancellation_body: You may cancel at any time. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. No partial refunds are issued.
legal.terms_ip_body: You retain all rights to the content you create. We retain all rights to the FocusMatrix software, brand and design.
legal.terms_warranty_body: The service is provided 'as is'. We do our best but cannot guarantee uninterrupted availability or fitness for any particular purpose.
legal.terms_liability_body: To the extent permitted by German law, our liability for damages is limited to the fees paid in the 12 months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. Liability for intentional acts, gross negligence and mandatory liability (e.g. product liability) is unaffected.
legal.terms_law_body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany. Place of jurisdiction is Munich for merchants, legal entities under public law and public special assets. Mandatory consumer protections remain unaffected.
legal.cookies_subtitle: We only use essential cookies. No tracking, no ads.
legal.cookies_intro: FocusMatrix is designed to respect your privacy. We do not use any advertising, analytics or tracking cookies. Only cookies strictly necessary to run the service are set.
legal.cookies_purpose_session: Keeps you signed in during your visit.
legal.cookies_purpose_csrf: Protects form submissions against CSRF attacks.
legal.cookies_purpose_consent: Records that you have seen the cookie banner.
legal.cookies_tracking_body: We do not use Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, Hotjar, Mixpanel or similar tools. We do not use third‑party advertising cookies.
legal.cookies_opt_out_body: Because all cookies we set are strictly necessary, opting out would break authentication. You can still block cookies in your browser settings — the app will then not function.
legal.cookies_banner_body: FocusMatrix only uses essential cookies for login and language preferences. No tracking, no ads.
legal.gdpr_export_desc: Receive a JSON export of all data we store about you (GDPR Art. 15 & 20).
legal.gdpr_delete_desc: Permanently remove your account and all associated data (GDPR Art. 17).

landing.hero_sub: FocusMatrix is the operating system for managers who want to lead, not juggle tasks. Built on the Only-You-Principle: if someone else can do it at least as well, you shouldn't.
landing.principle_q: Can only I really do this?
landing.principle_sub: Every task gets routed into Keep, Delegate, or Drop. No more being a processor of other people's work.
landing.matrix_delegate_sub: Structured goal, frame, resources — no micromanagement
landing.matrix_drop_sub: Meetings without decisions. Reports without readers.
landing.feature_dashboard_d: Focus score, streaks and weekly clarity.
landing.feature_inbox_d: Every task forced through the Only-You question.
landing.feature_keep_d: Auto-tagged into the four Only-You categories.
landing.feature_delegate_d: Goal, frame, deadline, scope, resources, backing.
landing.feature_drop_d: Boldly kill meetings and reports that don't serve a goal.
landing.feature_selfcheck_d: Friday ritual. Did I focus on the few important decisions?
landing.feature_orgcheck_d: Who decides what. By when. Clear responsibilities.
landing.feature_ai_d: Smart triage suggestions and delegation drafts.
landing.footer_principle: If someone else can do it at least as well, I shouldn't.
